label: Grip strength response - detailed - at age 69 years
meta_rows: Grip strength response - detailed - at age 69 years
2015 Hand grip test. More information available in the documentation.
cat_rows: During the clinic (or home) visit at age 60-64 years study participants were asked by the attending nurse whether they would be willing to have their grip strength assessed.  If willing and able (reasons for inability included health reasons and broken dynamometers) up to 6 tests of grip strength were performed, 3 in the dominant hand and 3 in the non-dominant hand, using a Nottingham electronic dynamometer.
val_rows: Questions not asked in paper home visit
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
